photos.title: File:Canal Park td (2018-11-05) 01.jpg
photos.author: Tdorante10
photos.description: The western entrance into Canal Park, on the east side of West Street and Canal Street near the Holland Tunnel in TriBeCa, Manhattan. The park was designated as parkland in 1686, and developed in 1888 by Calvert Vaux and Samuel B. Parsons Jr. , but was destroyed for the construction of the Holland Tunnel. The 1888 design of the park was restored between 2000 and 2005.
